doc:
A (left) ideal in a semiring `R` is an additive submonoid `s` such that
`a * b ∈ s` whenever `b ∈ s`. If `R` is a ring, then `s` is an additive subgroup.
statement: (R : Type u) → [Semiring R] → Type u

doc: A left ideal `I : Ideal R` is two-sided if it is also a right ideal.
statement: {α : Type u} → [inst : Semiring α] → Ideal α → Prop
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Semiring α] {I : Ideal α}, (∀ {a : α} (b : α), a ∈ I → a * b ∈ I) → I.IsTwoSided
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Semiring α] (I : Ideal α), I.IsTwoSided ↔ ∀ {a : α} (b : α), a ∈ I → a * b ∈ I
∀ {α : Type u} {inst : Semiring α} {I : Ideal α} [self : I.IsTwoSided] {a : α} (b : α), a ∈ I → a * b ∈ I
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Semiring α] (I : Ideal α), 0 ∈ I
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Semiring α] (I : Ideal α) {a b : α}, a ∈ I → b ∈ I → a + b ∈ I
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Semiring α] (I : Ideal α) (a : α) {b : α}, b ∈ I → a * b ∈ I
∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} (b : α) [inst : Semiring α] (I : Ideal α) [I.IsTwoSided], a ∈ I → a * b ∈ I
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Semiring α] {I J : Ideal α}, (∀ (x : α), x ∈ I ↔ x ∈ J) → I = J
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Semiring α] {I J : Ideal α}, I = J ↔ ∀ (x : α), x ∈ I ↔ x ∈ J
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Semiring α] (I : Ideal α) {x y : α}, IsUnit y → (y * x ∈ I ↔ x ∈ I)
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Semiring α] (I : Ideal α) {a : α}, a ∈ I → ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → a ^ n ∈ I
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Semiring α] (I : Ideal α) {a : α} {m n : ℕ}, a ^ m ∈ I → m ≤ n → a ^ n ∈ I

doc:
For two elements `m` and `m'` in an `R`-module `M`, the set of elements `r : R` with
equal scalar product with `m` and `m'` is an ideal of `R`. If `M` is a group, this coincides
with the kernel of `LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R M (m - m')`.
statement: (R : Type u_1) → {M : Type u_2} → [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [Module R M] → M → M → Ideal R
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring α] (I : Ideal α) {x y : α}, IsUnit y → (x * y ∈ I ↔ x ∈ I)
∀ {α : Type u} {a b : α} [inst : CommSemiring α] (I : Ideal α), a ∣ b → a ∈ I → b ∈ I
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Ring α] (I : Ideal α) {a : α}, -a ∈ I ↔ a ∈ I
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Ring α] (I : Ideal α) {a b : α}, b ∈ I → (a + b ∈ I ↔ a ∈ I)
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Ring α] (I : Ideal α) {a b : α}, a ∈ I → (a + b ∈ I ↔ b ∈ I)
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Ring α] (I : Ideal α) {a b : α}, a ∈ I → b ∈ I → a - b ∈ I
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Ring α] (I : Ideal α) {a b c d : α} [I.IsTwoSided], a - b ∈ I → c - d ∈ I → a * c - b * d ∈ I

doc: The subgroup of elements `g` of `G` such that `∀ x, g • x - x ∈ I`.
statement: {α : Type u} → [inst : Ring α] → (G : Type u_1) → [inst_1 : Group G] → [MulAction G α] → Ideal α → Subgroup G

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Ring α] {G : Type u_1} [inst_1 : Group G] [inst_2 : MulAction G α] {I : Ideal α} {σ : G},
  σ ∈ Ideal.inertia G I ↔ ∀ (x : α), σ • x - x ∈ I

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Ring α] {G : Type u_1} [inst_1 : Group G] [inst_2 : MulAction G α] {I : Ideal α} {H : Subgroup G}
  {σ : ↥H}, ↑σ ∈ Ideal.inertia G I ↔ σ ∈ Ideal.inertia (↥H) I
